name: Inoue Yukina
source:
Satoru and Maiko's child.

Yukina seems to be similar to her mother, in that she's loud and confident. In class at school, she's very much the one in charge, and all of the kids do whatever she says. However, she does have a tendency to act like something of a bully. She acts very bratty around her dad because he's too weak-willed to scold her properly, but she behaves herself impeccably around her mother.

One of her newfound hobbies involves pulling her teeth out the moment they begin to feel even just a little bit wobbly -- even though it must be far too early for them to fall out yet...

Her favorite food is smoked cheese, and her dream is to have a large, white dog she can ride on.
